actions.name: assign_position
actions.summary: Record that a person takes over a position nobody holds, from a date.
actions.signature: person: ref ppl:Person, position: ref org:Position, since: date

actions.name: create_task
actions.summary: Open a task for a person, optionally with a due date.
actions.signature: title: string, due?: date, assignee: ref ppl:Person

actions.name: hand_over_position
actions.summary: Replace the current holder of a position by another person, from a date.
actions.signature: position: ref org:Position, person: ref ppl:Person, since?: date

actions.name: offboard_employee
actions.summary: Record that an employee has left; remove their positions and employer first.
